analysis.course_description: precalculus, analysis, algebra, probability, vectors, matrices, etc.

atps.unit_description: pascal's triangle, binomial theorem, fibonacci numbers, etc.

limits and calculus.unit_description: ap calculus a, easy limits, derivatives up to chain rule, very light antiderivatives, etc.

gatm.unit_description: eigenvectors, eigenvalues, 2d rotation matrices, mapping planes to matrices

matrices.unit_description: addition, multiplication, identity, gauss-jordan, markov chain, determinant, very light application, etc.

polar and 3d.unit_description: polar coordinates, polar shapes (lemniscate, polar rose, etc.), polar to rectangular, 3d graphics, 3d conics (hyperbola, sphere, etc.), all algebraic, no calculus, etc.

probability.unit_description: dice, cards, gambling, lottery, population, choices, venn diagrams, etc.

vectors and parametrics.unit_description: unit vectors, normal vectors, planes, dot product, cross product, 3d vectors, 2d conics, parametric equations, parametric curves, parametric surfaces, etc.

calcbc.course_description: ap calculus bc, single variable derivatives and integrals, differential equations, etc.

ap test review.unit_description: ap test review, free response, multiple choice, cumulative review, etc.

application of integrals.unit_description: area, volume, arc length, surface area, etc.

derivatives.unit_description: basic derivatives, iroc, aroc, differentiable, etc.

differential equations.unit_description: separation of variables, slope fields, euler's method, logistic growth, etc.

integrals.unit_description: u-sub, trig integrals, trig substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions, etc.

limits and continuity.unit_description: limits at infinity, limits with l'hopital's rule, continuity, etc.

more application of derivatives.unit_description: linear approximations, mean value theorem, relative extrema, absolute extrema, increasing/decreasing, concavity, inflection points, etc.

more derivatives.unit_description: tangent line of a curve, inverse functions, nth derivative, etc.

polar and parametric.unit_description: parametric derivatives and differentials, polar areas, polar arc length, etc.

sequences and series.unit_description: Taylor series, Maclaurin series, convergence tests (ratio test, root test), power series, etc.

stats.course_description: ap statistics, data analysis, probability, confidence integral, chi square tests, etc.

c1 & c2 describing data.unit_description: data, distributions, histograms, box plots, stem and leaf plots, mean, median, mode, range, variance, standard deviation, z scores, etc, do not include difficult tests like t-test, chi square, hypothesis testing, etc.

c3 two-variable, scatterplots, linear re.unit_description: scatterplots, correlation, linear regression (linear, not quadratic), residuals, least squares regression line, etc, no hypothesis testing, no t-test, no chi square, etc.

c4 experimental design.unit_description: experiments, observational studies, surveys, bias, randomization, confounding variables, how to design an experiment, different experimental designs, etc, no confidence intervals, no hypothesis testing, no t-test, no chi square, etc.

c5 & c6 probability and random variables.unit_name: c5 & c6 probability and random variables
c5 & c6 probability and random variables.unit_description: probability, random variables, binomial distribution, geometric distribution, normal distribution, standard normal distribution, z-scores, etc.

c7 sampling distributions.unit_description: sampling distributions, central limit theorem, standard error, etc.

c8 confidence intervals.unit_description: confidence intervals, margin of error, t-distribution, z-distribution, conditions, etc.

c9 & c10 significance tests and more cis.unit_name: c9 & c10 significance tests and more CIs
c9 & c10 significance tests and more cis.unit_description: significance tests, hypothesis testing, p-values, type I and type II errors, power of a test, confidence intervals for proportions, t-tests and z-tests, means, and differences, etc.

c11 chi-square sig tests.unit_description: chi-square tests, goodness of fit, independence, homogeneity, etc.

c12 linear regression t-int and t-test.unit_name: c12 linear regression t-int and t-test
c12 linear regression t-int and t-test.unit_description: linear regression, t-tests, confidence intervals for slope, residuals, etc.
